description:
[FREE] Semantic Contract Drift Detector (AgentWorld invention 3857).

Scores natural-language supplier communication for ambiguity (0.0 explicit,
1.0 maximally vague) with flags for vague phrases, explicit commitments
found, a verdict (LOW/MODERATE/HIGH) and a rationale. Catch 'best effort'
language before it becomes financial drift. Max 8000 chars.
name: get_ambiguity_score
